mapper.select: SELECT comment_id, post_id, member_id, parent_id, content, is_deleted, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at FROM comments WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND is_deleted = 'N' ORDER BY created_at DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
SELECT comment_id, post_id, member_id, parent_id, content, is_deleted, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at FROM comments WHERE comment_id = #{commentId}
SELECT comment_id, post_id, member_id, parent_id, content, is_deleted, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at FROM comments WHERE parent_id = #{parentId} AND is_deleted = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comments ( post_id, member_id, parent_id, content, is_deleted, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{postId}, #{memberId}, #{parentId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{content}, #{isDeleted}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE comments SET content = #{content}, updated_at = SYSDATE WHERE comment_id = #{commentId}
mapper.select: SELECT comment_id, post_id, member_id, parent_id, content, is_deleted, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at FROM comments WHERE (comment_id = #{commentId} OR parent_id = #{commentId}) AND is_deleted = 'N'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND is_deleted = 'N'

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT c.comment_id, c.post_id, c.member_id, c.parent_id, c.content, c.is_deleted, c.created_at, c.updated_at, c.deleted_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment_likes WHERE comment_id = c.comment_id) as like_count FROM comments c WHERE c.post_id = #{postId} AND c.is_deleted = 'N' ORDER BY like_count DESC, c.created_at ASC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1 AND like_count > 0
